tools.name: list_iterations
tools.description: Open Lab @R# rows as the same dump as Live rules (parent, headline @B#, Long/Position/Exit).

tools.name: get_lineage
tools.description: Champion @R#, per-iteration verdicts, levers tried/untried/failed on champion, converged flag, and user canvas view vs recommended working @R#.

tools.name: select_iteration
tools.description: Load an @R# onto the live canvas so mutate tools edit that iteration.

tools.name: add_entry_gate
tools.description: Add one AND entry gate. Args: side + condition JSON. You are the DSL translator. Invent the section JSON (condition/position/exit/cooldown). Lab applies only — BenAwf does not call an LLM. No prose text.

tools.name: patch_entry_gate
tools.description: Replace one entry gate by id. Args: id + condition JSON. You are the DSL translator. Invent the section JSON (condition/position/exit/cooldown). Lab applies only — BenAwf does not call an LLM. No prose text.

tools.name: delete_entry_gate
tools.description: Remove one entry gate by id (from get_experiment). Args: id only. Refuses when it would leave both long and short with zero gates.

tools.name: patch_position
tools.description: Full replace of rules.position. Args: position JSON. You are the DSL translator. Invent the section JSON (condition/position/exit/cooldown). Lab applies only — BenAwf does not call an LLM. No prose text.

tools.name: patch_exit
tools.description: Full replace of rules.exit. Args: exit JSON. You are the DSL translator. Invent the section JSON (condition/position/exit/cooldown). Lab applies only — BenAwf does not call an LLM. No prose text.

tools.name: patch_cooldown
tools.description: Set root cooldownMinutes. Args: cooldownMinutes number|null. You are the DSL translator. Invent the section JSON (condition/position/exit/cooldown). Lab applies only — BenAwf does not call an LLM. No prose text.

tools.name: list_strategies
tools.description: Ids, @R# refs, and backtest headlines for strategies not currently open.

tools.name: list_backtests
tools.description: Open Lab @B# rows with window, assets, trade count, PnL, win rate, drawdown, and tape_stripped.

tools.name: get_backtest
tools.description: Cache-or-run one sim for an @R# + window, then return Score, trade count, PnL, drawdown, and bounded stats for one run. Numbers only — no BenAwf assessment LLM; you analyze. tools.name: list_trades
tools.description: One page of fills (20 per page): trade_id, side, prices, PnL.

tools.name: get_experiment
tools.description: Prose summary plus rules JSON (entry gates with ids, position, exit, cooldownMinutes) and that iteration's @B# refs. Read before inventing translator-shaped mutate args.

tools.name: diff_dsl
tools.description: Structured rules diff between two @R# iterations (entry gates per side, position, exit, cooldown). Use before adopting an older iteration's levers onto a newer one.

tools.name: get_market_context_by_date
tools.description: OHLCV and cited indicators around that date (engine lookback each side).

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "prompt:get_started" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Onboarding for users who have not signed up: how to create a free BenAwf account, generate an API key, and connect this MCP server before using the tools.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "add_entry_gate" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
